children: Gold futures are down 0.5% at $4,331.20 a troy ounce in morning European trade. The fall comes as higher energy prices reinforce expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve will begin raising rates, ANZ analysts say. Higher interest rates weigh on non-yield assets like gold. Tightening oil supplies push Brent crude up 2% to $107.70 a barrel. Expectations of higher inflation mean traders now price in an 86% probability of a hike at next week's meeting, they say.(adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
